units.title: 磁铁实验桌的测试顺序

materials.title: Magnet Table Checks 036A
materials.text: At the magnet table, test one object at a time. The adult checks the iron clips before they go in the small tray. Keep the magnets away from the computer cards. Mark the result after each test. If two magnets stick together, ask the teacher to separate them.

questions.prompt: A friend tests two objects together. Say: ____
options: Put every clip in the tray.
Test one object at a time.
questions.explanation: C直接纠两物同时测；A提前标、B全入盘均不处理逐一测试条件。

questions.prompt: A friend puts unchecked iron clips in the tray. Say: ____
options: Wait for the adult to check them first.
questions.explanation: A铁夹先成人检查再入盘；B电脑位置不核夹；C违单物测试。

questions.prompt: A friend puts a magnet beside the computer cards. Say: ____
options: Put the cards in the small tray.
Keep the magnet away from those cards.
questions.explanation: B磁铁远卡直接解决；A把卡入铁夹盘、C标结果不改位置。

questions.prompt: A friend marks a result before testing. Say: ____
options: Mark what happens after the test.
questions.explanation: C测后按实际结果记；A全同虚记，B问课不纠先记。

questions.prompt: Two magnets stick together. Your friend pulls hard. Say: ____
options: Ask the teacher to separate them.
Put them beside the computer cards.
questions.explanation: B指定教师分离；A独拉不遵求助，C靠卡违别项规则。

units.title: 看牙时说清楚自己的需要

materials.title: Dentist Telling Needs 036A
materials.text: A child is visiting a dentist with a parent. Choose the sentence that expresses the stated need; no treatment decision is required.

questions.prompt: Your front tooth feels loose. You need to tell the dentist. Say: ____
questions.explanation: B报告前牙松动感受；A杯、C等候室不陈述牙齿状态。

questions.prompt: You want to see brushing shown on the large tooth model. Ask: ____
options: Could you show me on that model?
Could you check the appointment time?
questions.explanation: A请求在模型演示；B预约时、C找衣与所需展示无关。

questions.prompt: You want a short pause. Ask: ____
options: May I have a short break, please?
questions.explanation: C直接请求短暂停；A房位、B选笔不表达暂停需求。

questions.prompt: Your coat is still in the waiting room. You want to check before leaving. Say to Dad: ____
options: May we choose a new bag?
May we check the waiting room for my coat?
questions.explanation: C离前找等候室外套；A牙模型、B新包不核遗物。

questions.prompt: You have finished with a paper cup and need its return place. Ask: ____
options: Where should I put this used cup?
What time is the next visit?
Can I see the model again?
questions.explanation: A问用后杯去处；B下次时、C再看模型不解决收杯。

units.title: 乘火车出行的十段完整句子

materials.title: Train Trip Ten Sentences 036A
materials.text: Choose the word or reply that fits each full train-trip situation.

questions.prompt: We see ____ owl on the post for the first time.
questions.explanation: C owl元音开头单数用an；A a不合元音冠词；B two后需owls。

questions.prompt: Dad and I ____ ready to board with our bags.
questions.explanation: A Dad and I复数are；B am只配I独立主语；C is单数不合并列。

questions.prompt: Mum asks for the route card. Please give it to ____.
questions.explanation: B to后宾格her指Mum；A主格、C物主不作所需人物宾语。

questions.prompt: The train door is closed. We ____ get on through it now.
questions.explanation: C cannot与门闭无法此刻上车一致；A/B be后不直接接get原形。

questions.prompt: The display has two model ____ beside the woodland scene.
questions.explanation: A two要求foxes标准复数；B单数，C缺es拼错。

questions.prompt: The train runs ____ rails, not across the grass.
questions.explanation: B on rails为轨道上运行；A rails内非此义，C before时间不表行驶位置。

questions.prompt: The announcement gives our platform. We listen ____ so we do not miss it.
questions.explanation: C carefully认真听避免漏信息；A困的、B圆的不表达合适倾听方式。

questions.prompt: ____ does the next train leave? At four.
questions.explanation: A At four答时间When；B人物、C地点不对应。

questions.prompt: These two seats are for Dad and me. They are ____.
questions.explanation: B ours独立物主表语后无名词；A our需名词，C us宾格不表所有。

questions.prompt: We have ten minutes to wait. Shall we ____ a quiet word game?
questions.explanation: B Shall we后play原形；A单三、C分词不合该建议问句。

units.title: 出游路线上的五个确认

materials.title: Outing Route Replies 036A
materials.text:
Match each question with its best reply. Use each reply once.
A. At the new entrance beside the bridge.
B. Only after the whole group arrives.
C. The helper with an orange badge.
D. Because the west staircase is closed.
E. Yes, but return it to the desk after use.

questions.prompt: Why are we using a different staircase today?
options: At the new entrance beside the bridge.
Only after the whole group arrives.
The helper with an orange badge.
Because the west staircase is closed.
Yes, but return it to the desk after use.
questions.explanation: D西梯关闭解释改梯；A入口处、B到齐时机、C人、E借还条件不答原因。

questions.prompt: Where do we meet after the walk?
options: At the new entrance beside the bridge.
Only after the whole group arrives.
The helper with an orange badge.
Because the west staircase is closed.
Yes, but return it to the desk after use.
questions.explanation: A桥旁新入口答集合地；B时机、C人员、D关梯原因、E许可不答Where。

questions.prompt: Who can help us check the route card?
options: At the new entrance beside the bridge.
Only after the whole group arrives.
The helper with an orange badge.
Because the west staircase is closed.
Yes, but return it to the desk after use.
questions.explanation: C橙牌帮手答人员；A地点、B时间、D原因、E借还条件不答Who。

questions.prompt: May I borrow this map for the afternoon?
options: At the new entrance beside the bridge.
Only after the whole group arrives.
The helper with an orange badge.
Because the west staircase is closed.
Yes, but return it to the desk after use.
questions.explanation: E可但用后回台，答借图许可；A集合处、B到齐时机、C人、D梯因不回答借用条件。

questions.prompt: When may we leave the meeting point together?
options: At the new entrance beside the bridge.
Only after the whole group arrives.
The helper with an orange badge.
Because the west staircase is closed.
Yes, but return it to the desk after use.
questions.explanation: B全组到后答出发时机；A入口、C人员、D关梯原因、E借图归还不答When。

units.title: 科学展台核对的五个词

materials.title: Science Display Bank 036A
materials.text:
Read the full passage and use every bank word once. Bank: A. between B. gently C. list D. dry E. before
A helper checks each model against a ____1____. The display table stands ____2____ the two wide doors. We keep the paper cards ____3____ so the ink does not run. Visitors may press the safe sample ____4____, without pushing hard. All loose parts are counted ____5____ the boxes are closed.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: C list为核对清单；A between空间、B gently方式、D dry状态、E before时间均不作该名单名词。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: A between two doors表示两门间；B gently方式、C list名词、D dry状态、E before时间不表此空间。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: D keep cards dry防墨散；A between、E before介词，B gently副词、C list名词不作干燥状态表语。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: B gently轻压与without pushing hard对应；A between空间、C list名词、D dry状态、E before时间不表达按压方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: E before先点件后合箱；A between空间、B gently方式、C list名词、D dry状态不连接此时间句。

units.title: 开放教室里的五个具体回答

materials.title: Open Room Replies 036A
materials.text:
Match each question to the reply that fits it. Use each reply once.
A. Yes, if it stays on the marked table.
B. The teacher carrying the visitor list.
C. After the last group has left.
D. Because the surface is not dry yet.
E. On the shelf labelled for collected work.

questions.prompt: Where should already collected class work be placed?
options: Yes, if it stays on the marked table.
The teacher carrying the visitor list.
After the last group has left.
Because the surface is not dry yet.
On the shelf labelled for collected work.
questions.explanation: E已取回作品标签架答存处；A许可、B人员、C时机、D湿面原因不答Where。

questions.prompt: Why must we wait before stacking these painted cards?
options: Yes, if it stays on the marked table.
The teacher carrying the visitor list.
After the last group has left.
Because the surface is not dry yet.
On the shelf labelled for collected work.
questions.explanation: D表面未干解释不叠；A许可、B人、C访组离后、E架位不答漆状态原因。

questions.prompt: May I use this demonstration model?
options: Yes, if it stays on the marked table.
The teacher carrying the visitor list.
After the last group has left.
Because the surface is not dry yet.
On the shelf labelled for collected work.
questions.explanation: A可以但留标桌，答示范模型许可；B人、C收尾时机、D湿卡原因、E作品架不答此条件。

questions.prompt: When should we pack away the visitor materials?
options: Yes, if it stays on the marked table.
The teacher carrying the visitor list.
After the last group has left.
Because the surface is not dry yet.
On the shelf labelled for collected work.
questions.explanation: C最后组离后答收资料时机；A模型许可、B人、D原因、E架位不答When。

questions.prompt: Who can confirm whether our visitors have all arrived?
options: Yes, if it stays on the marked table.
The teacher carrying the visitor list.
After the last group has left.
Because the surface is not dry yet.
On the shelf labelled for collected work.
questions.explanation: B带访客名单教师答人员；A许可、C时机、D原因、E存处不答Who。

units.title: 印章上的字为什么反了

materials.title: Mirror Stamp Eight Cloze 036A
materials.text:
Read the whole story and choose the best word for every numbered gap.
We made a class stamp with ready-cut foam letters. The first print came out ____1____, although the letters on the block had looked normal to us. The teacher held it beside a ____2____ and explained the reversal. We needed to turn and arrange the foam pieces for the printed ____3____, not only for how the block looked. We made one test print ____4____ making the final cards. This time, we ____5____ each letter and the word order. We pressed the block ____6____ so the ink would not spread. We kept the first ____7____ print to show what had changed. At last, visitors could ____8____ our class name easily.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: B backwards与后文reversal和镜子解释相应；A早、C饿不描述字印反向。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: C mirror展示反向；A篮、B钟不是此处字形倒向比较工具。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: A为printed result最终印出结果排字；B天气、C食谱不对应班名章。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: C先试印再正式卡；A下、B之间不连接该动名词先后。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B checked逐字与词序核；A煮、C睡不验证文字。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: A gently轻压避免墨散；B木制、C渴非所需施压方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 7?
questions.explanation: B first mistaken print保留初错误作对照；A完整不是所强调的错向，C无声不描述印字错误。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 8?
questions.explanation: C read班名印字易读为目标；A搬、B爬不对文本识读。

units.title: 延期手工课的材料包选择

materials.title: Cancelled Materials Workshop Notice 036A
materials.text:
Workshop notice
Saturday’s outdoor weaving workshop is postponed because the garden roof needs repair. A new date will be confirmed next week. Booked pupils may either keep their place or request a refund by Wednesday. The organisers have already prepared material packs. Anyone taking a refund should leave the pack uncollected. Pupils keeping a place may collect their sealed pack early, but should not open it until the teacher gives the revised instructions. If the new date is unsuitable, another refund opportunity will be offered. Postponement does not mean pupils must accept any future date.

questions.prompt: The notice already gives a confirmed replacement date.
questions.explanation: B正确：新日下周确认，当前未定；A把未来确认当已给。

questions.prompt: Booked pupils can choose to keep a place or request a refund by Wednesday.
questions.explanation: A正确：either keep or refund byWednesday；B否认已给选择。

questions.prompt: Anyone requesting a refund should collect and open the materials first.
questions.explanation: B正确：退者包不取，保留者封包也待新说明；A把两种条件都反向。

questions.prompt: Pupils who keep places may collect sealed packs early.
questions.explanation: A正确：keeping place sealedpack early允许；B否认材料领取条件。

questions.prompt: A pupil may get another refund chance if the new date does not work.
questions.explanation: A正确：newdate unsuitable anotherrefund；B把延期当必须接受任何日期。

units.title: 冬日活动笔记的词形

materials.title: Winter Event Note Forms 036A
materials.text:
Complete every gap using the correct one-word form of the given word.
1. Last winter, the club ____1____ (keep) spare coats for visitors who needed them.
2. We washed three woollen ____2____ (scarf) after the event.
3. This cushion feels ____3____ (soft) than the old one beside it.
4. Look! The youngest pupils are ____4____ (dance) in the warm hall.
5. The group waited ____5____ (eager; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly) for the next song.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use KEEP.
questions.explanation: 接受kept：Last winter过去，keep不规则；keep原形、keeped错、keeping分词非过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use SCARF.
questions.explanation: 接受scarves或scarfs两种常用标准复数；three排除scarf单数，scarveses重复复数，scarf’s所有格不表本句数量。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use SOFT.
questions.explanation: 接受softer：than明确比较触感；soft原级、softest最高级、softness名词不作所需比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use DANCE.
questions.explanation: 接受dancing：are进行，dance去e加ing；dance原形、danceing错拼、danced过去式不合正在跳。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from EAGER.
questions.explanation: 接受eagerly：本空明示EAGER常规-ly副词；eager、eagerness、eagerer不满足本空形态要求，不概括其他语境合法性，未列复核。

units.title: 和笔友通信时把意思问清楚

materials.title: Penpal Clarification Functions 036A
materials.text: Choose the sentence that directly achieves the stated purpose. Other options are plausible messages but ask for different information.

questions.prompt: A pen pal suggests a video call at six but lives in another time zone. You need to know whose six o’clock. What should you ask?
options: What would you like to discuss?
Do you mean six in your time zone or mine?
questions.explanation: B核时区解决六点歧义；A话题、C设备不确定实际同一时刻。

questions.prompt: You are unsure how the pen pal prefers their name to be pronounced. What should you ask?
options: What colour notebook do you use?
Could you tell me how you pronounce your name?
questions.explanation: C询本人姓名读法；A笔记色、B生日不提供读音。

questions.prompt: A joke in a message is unclear, and you want its meaning explained. What should you say?
options: Could you send a shorter letter next time?
Would you like a photo of my school?
I do not understand that joke. Could you explain what you mean?
questions.explanation: C指出笑话未懂并求释义；A缩短信、B校照不澄清当前内容。

questions.prompt: You enjoy writing but cannot reply every day. You want to agree on a realistic pace. What should you say?
options: I enjoy our letters. Could we plan to reply about once a week?
questions.explanation: A表达重视并协商每周频率；B邮票偏好、C班室描述不设回信节奏。

questions.prompt: You want to put a pen pal’s short poem in your class booklet. You need permission. What should you ask?
options: How many lines did you write?
May we include your poem in our class booklet with your name as agreed?
Which book did you read yesterday?
questions.explanation: B明确作品使用与署名许可；A行数、C昨读书不获使用授权。

units.title: 保龄球活动中的具体安排

materials.title: Bowling Family Turns 036B
materials.text: At family bowling, ask the helper to choose a light ball that fits your hand. Carry the ball with two hands. Roll only when your lane is ready. Do not go into the pin machine area; ask staff if something is stuck. Return rented shoes before leaving.

questions.prompt: Your friend cannot hold the heavy ball well. Say: ____
options: Ask the helper for a lighter ball that fits.
Choose the biggest ball on the shelf.
questions.explanation: B助手选轻且合手球解决握不住；A分数无关；C更大未必合手且反当前需要。

questions.prompt: A friend carries a ball carelessly in one hand. Say: ____
questions.explanation: C双手搬球符合规则；A鞋、B隔道不纠当前持球。

questions.prompt: Your lane is not ready, but your friend wants to roll. Say: ____
options: Wait until our lane is ready.
questions.explanation: A本道就绪前等；B投别道不许可，C鞋架无关开始条件。

questions.prompt: Something is stuck near the pin machine. Your friend walks towards it. Say: ____
options: Stay out and ask staff for help.
questions.explanation: C不入机器区，找员工；A带球、B继续走均违边界。

questions.prompt: You are leaving. Your friend still wears rented shoes. Say: ____
questions.explanation: B离前还租鞋；A留到明日、C装包都不是归还。

units.title: 去朋友家做客时的安排

materials.title: Visiting Friend Home Rules 036B
materials.text: At our friend’s home, ask before opening a bedroom door. Wet umbrellas go in the tray by the entrance. Keep the dog gate shut. The cake is for after the game. Before taking a toy home, ask its owner and tell your parent.

questions.prompt: A friend reaches for a closed bedroom door. Say: ____
options: Ask when we eat the cake.
questions.explanation: A卧室开门前先问；B蛋糕时、C雨伞是其他安排不授予开门许可。

questions.prompt: A wet umbrella drips on the carpet. Say: ____
options: Put it on the cake table.
Leave it by the dog gate.
Put it in the entrance tray.
questions.explanation: C湿伞入口盘；A食桌、B狗门旁不是指定收纳处。

questions.prompt: Your friend leaves the dog gate open. Say: ____
questions.explanation: B直接纠门敞开；A开玩、C换玩具不关门。

questions.prompt: The game has not started, and a friend asks for cake. Say: ____
options: The cake is for after the game.
questions.explanation: B蛋糕在游戏后；A提前违顺序，C卧室位置不答用餐时机。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to take a toy home. Say: ____
options: Put it in your bag quietly.
Ask the owner first and tell your parent.
questions.explanation: C物主许可并告家长；A静装未问，B换话题不解决借带。

units.title: 早市里的十段完整句子

materials.title: Market Morning Ten Choices 036B
materials.text: Read each full market-morning situation and choose the best word or reply.

questions.prompt: The seller ____ weighing the apples on the scales now.
questions.explanation: C seller单数is加weighing；A复数are，B I配am均不合。

questions.prompt: We carry two paper ____ for the vegetables.
questions.explanation: A two要求bags标准复数；B单数；C拼写错。

questions.prompt: The fruit box belongs to Mum and Dad. It is ____ box.
questions.explanation: B Mum and Dad复数物主their；A/C仅单个人称不表两人共同所有。

questions.prompt: ____ milk do we need? One bottle is enough.
questions.explanation: C milk不可数用How much；A many修可数复数，B人称问词不问份量。

questions.prompt: I cannot carry this bag alone. Could you ____ me?
questions.explanation: A Could you后help原形；B单三、C分词不合。

questions.prompt: Do these apples have small seeds? Yes, they ____.
questions.explanation: B Do问用do答且they复数；A are不回答have助动词问句，C does不配they。

questions.prompt: The basket is empty. There is ____ fruit in it yet.
questions.explanation: C no fruit与empty一致；A some表示有，B a不能直接修本句不可数fruit。

questions.prompt: Please ____ the coins before putting them in your pocket.
questions.explanation: B祈使count原形；A单三、C分词不独立构成指令。

questions.prompt: The helper gives us the receipt. We keep ____ with the shopping list.
questions.explanation: A keep后宾格it指收据；B物主、C反身本句无主宾同一不合。

questions.prompt: ____ can show us the bread stall? The helper beside the gate.
questions.explanation: B helper答人物Who；A时间、C地点不回答谁带路。

units.title: 饮水龙头没水时的替代地点

materials.title: Dry Tap Alternative Order 036B
materials.text:
Order the conversation. The fixed first line is: 1. The drinking tap has no water.
A. Do I take my bottle there?
B. Yes, by the sports room.
C. Okay. I will tell the others where to go.
D. Is another drinking tap working?
E. Yes, and leave this tap closed.
Choose each line’s position from 2 to 6.

questions.prompt: What position does line A take?
questions.explanation: C第4步听到替代地点后问是否带瓶去；A第2步先问另龙头，B第3步给地点，D第5步答并关旧龙头，E第6步告知。

questions.prompt: What position does line B take?
questions.explanation: B第3步Yes回答另处是否正常并给体育室旁；A第2步应先问，C第4步带瓶问，D第5步答，E第6步通知。

questions.prompt: What position does line C take?
questions.explanation: E第6步方案确定后告知其他人；A/B/C/D第2至5分别问替代、答地点、问带瓶、答关旧龙头。

questions.prompt: What position does line D take?
questions.explanation: A第2步针对没水问另处工作否；B第3步答，C第4步行动问，D第5步确认，E第6步传达。

questions.prompt: What position does line E take?
questions.explanation: D第5步Yes回应带瓶去，并提醒旧龙头闭；A第2步未提供替代，B第3步应地点，C第4步才问带瓶，E第6步通知。

units.title: 手制书封面的五个词

materials.title: Handmade Book Covers Bank 036B
materials.text:
Complete the passage with the shared bank. Use each word once. Bank: A. check B. inside C. carefully D. after E. thick
We choose ____1____ paper for the book covers so they are stronger than thin sheets. We fold it ____2____ to keep the corners neat. Each book goes ____3____ its new cover. Helpers ____4____ that the title is visible. We put books back only ____5____ all name cards have been matched.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: E thick与thin对照，厚纸保护封面；A check动作、B inside方位、C carefully方式、D after时间不形容纸厚。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: C carefully小心折使角整齐；A check动词、B inside位置、D after时间、E thick形容词不表所需折法。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: B inside cover在新封内；A check动作、C carefully方式、D after时间、E thick状态均非所需空间。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A check that核标题可见；B inside、D after介词，C carefully副词、E thick形容词不作核验谓语。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: D after名卡匹配完后才上架；A check、B inside、C carefully、E thick不连接这个时间从句。

units.title: 营地展览的五个问题

materials.title: Camp Exhibition Questions 036B
materials.text:
Match each question to its best reply. Use every answer once.
A. On the table beside the visitor map.
B. Because the cover is still wet.
C. Yes, if the owner agrees first.
D. The adult checking the group list.
E. After everyone has returned to the meeting point.

questions.prompt: When may our group leave the camp display together?
options: On the table beside the visitor map.
Because the cover is still wet.
Yes, if the owner agrees first.
The adult checking the group list.
After everyone has returned to the meeting point.
questions.explanation: E全员回集合点后答离开时机；A桌位、B湿因、C许可、D人员不答When。

questions.prompt: Who can confirm that all pupils are back?
options: On the table beside the visitor map.
Because the cover is still wet.
Yes, if the owner agrees first.
The adult checking the group list.
After everyone has returned to the meeting point.
questions.explanation: D核组名单成人答人员；A位置、B原因、C许可、E离开时机不答Who。

questions.prompt: Why is this booklet left open to dry?
options: On the table beside the visitor map.
Because the cover is still wet.
Yes, if the owner agrees first.
The adult checking the group list.
After everyone has returned to the meeting point.
questions.explanation: B封面仍湿解释晾开；A桌位、C物主许可、D人、E时间不答书湿原因。

questions.prompt: Where are the spare information cards?
options: On the table beside the visitor map.
Because the cover is still wet.
Yes, if the owner agrees first.
The adult checking the group list.
After everyone has returned to the meeting point.
questions.explanation: A访客图旁桌答存处；B原因、C许可、D人、E时机不答Where。

questions.prompt: May I use another pupil’s model in my explanation?
options: On the table beside the visitor map.
Because the cover is still wet.
Yes, if the owner agrees first.
The adult checking the group list.
After everyone has returned to the meeting point.
questions.explanation: C物主先同意，答作品借用许可；A位置、B书湿、D名单人、E离开时机不授此使用权。

units.title: 农场工作犬为什么趴着休息

materials.title: Working Dog Rest Six Cloze 036B
materials.text:
Read the complete passage and choose a word for each numbered gap.
At the farm, we saw a dog ____1____ beside the barn. I wanted to throw a ball for it, but the farmer asked us to wait. The dog had just finished helping with the sheep and was ____2____. We watched the animals quietly ____3____ the farmer explained its work. We did not call the dog again and again. ____4____, when it woke and came to the farmer, we asked whether play was suitable. The farmer showed us a safe place and stayed with us. We had ____5____ first instead of deciding what the dog needed. The visit was better because we ____6____ to the person who knew its routine.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: B resting对应趴栏旁和后文woke；A印、C烹不描述狗休息。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: C刚工作需休息tired；A木制、B方不表工作后状态。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: A while解释时静看为同时动作；B空间、C除非不表达该时段。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: C Later等醒后推进时间；A里面是空间，B昨天不接本次先后。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B asked先问农夫再玩，对instead deciding；A喊、C借不获取判断。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: A listened to熟悉日常者；B画、C睡不对应接受解释。

units.title: 写给未来自己的信不是合同

materials.title: Future Self Letter Story 036B
materials.text:
At ten, Mira wrote a letter to her future self. She said she would become an animal doctor because her cat had been ill. Two years later, she opened the envelope during a school project. She now loved drawing bridges and wanted to learn design. The old promise made her feel uneasy.
Dad asked whether the letter was a contract or a record of what mattered to her then. Mira remembered the worry she had felt for the cat. That care had not disappeared. She still helped at a neighbour’s animal shelter, although her career idea had changed. She kept the old letter and wrote a new note explaining both the change and what remained. The two pages could tell a fuller story than either one alone.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the old letter?
questions.explanation: C十岁时自己写给未来；A父亲、B访客、D雇主均非作者。

questions.prompt: Why does Mira feel uneasy when opening it later?
options: Her current interest differs from the old promise.
The cat has eaten the letter.
questions.explanation: B现爱桥梁设计与旧兽医愿望不同；A/C/D无据。

questions.prompt: What distinction does Dad suggest?
options: Between two kinds of pet food.
Between a drawing and a printed map.
Between old and new envelopes only.
Between a binding contract and a record of past feelings.
questions.explanation: D合同与当时所重视记录之别；A食物、B地图、C只信封不答问题。

questions.prompt: How does Mira still show care for animals?
options: She helps at an animal shelter.
She claims to be a trained doctor.
She throws the old letter away.
questions.explanation: A仍帮动物收容所；B没弃设计；C未称专业医生；D保留信。

questions.prompt: What does she do with the two stages of her life?
options: Keep the old letter and add an honest new note.
Ask Dad to rewrite the old letter as his own.
questions.explanation: C保旧补新说明变化与保留；A藏、B假装不变、D父亲代写均非行动。

units.title: 社区展示笔记的词形

materials.title: Community Show Note Forms 036B
materials.text:
Complete every gap using the correct one-word form of each given word.
1. Last week, our class ____1____ (send) invitations to the community show.
2. The food display contained three small bowls of ____2____ (berry).
3. This room is ____3____ (warm) than the courtyard outside.
4. Look! The organiser is ____4____ (plan) the order of the short talks.
5. The children waved ____5____ (excited; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly) when the show began.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use SEND.
questions.explanation: 接受sent：Last week过去，send不规则；send原形、sended错、sending分词非过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use BERRY.
questions.explanation: 接受berries：多碗浆果作可数复数，berry辅音y变ies；berry无冠词单数不合本义，berrys错拼，berrieses重复复数。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use WARM.
questions.explanation: 接受warmer：than明确比较室温；warm原级、warmest最高级、warmth名词不合比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use PLAN.
questions.explanation: 接受planning：is进行，plan双写n；plan原形、planing是不同词plane的分词、planned过去式不表正在安排。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from EXCITED.
questions.explanation: 接受excitedly：本空明确要求EXCITED派生常规-ly副词。excited、exciting、excitement不满足本空形态要求，不据此否定其他语境合法性；未列形式复核。

units.title: 选择寄送服务时问准条件

materials.title: Parcel Service Functions 036B
materials.text: Choose the sentence that directly achieves the stated purpose. Other options are plausible counter questions but have different goals.

questions.prompt: You need to compare a cheaper service and a faster one before choosing. What should you ask?
options: Where can I buy another box?
Could you compare the price and expected delivery time of these two services?
What colour is the tracking label?
questions.explanation: B同时比较价与预计时，直接支持选择；A买盒、C标签色不比较两服务。

questions.prompt: An extra payment may be a refundable deposit or a permanent fee. You want its status clarified. What should you ask?
options: Can you spell the recipient’s town?
Where should I sign the form?
Is this amount refundable, or is it a service charge?
questions.explanation: C辨可退押金与服务费；A镇名拼写、B签名处不澄清金额性质。

questions.prompt: Tracking says "out for delivery," and you need to understand what that status means. What should you ask?
options: What does this tracking status tell me about the delivery stage?
Can I buy a larger envelope?
How heavy is the parcel limit?
questions.explanation: A问状态对应阶段；B信封、C限重不解释当前状态。

questions.prompt: You need to give a contact number but do not want it written on a public list. What should you ask?
options: Could you show me the postage stamps?
May I provide the contact number privately instead?
When does the counter open tomorrow?
questions.explanation: B请求私下给号解决公开性需要；A邮票、C开门时不改变提交渠道。

questions.prompt: You missed the collection deadline and want to know the available next steps. What should you ask?
options: Can I choose another wrapping colour?
What is the fastest new service?
What options are available now that I missed the collection deadline?
questions.explanation: C明确逾领取后的可选处理；A包装色、B新寄送速度不答现有件下一步。
